DOWN 3 BECAUSE THE LANE POPULATION CHANGED, WHICH IS WHY THIS ONE NEEDED A RE-MEASURE RATHER THAN A RE-STAMP. The floor of 411 is a true measurement of a tree that no longer exists: it described 26 integration lanes, ours being origin's 25 plus the speech lane. Resolving that commit in the 2026-09-04 rebase was a union rather than a pick-a-side -- origin had added mail, test_mail and mail_group where ours added speech -- so integration_tests.yml now carries 29 INSTALL entries where our side had 26 and origin's had 28.

The arithmetic is exact and checks: origin's three new lanes cover three modules that were unlaned in our tree, so 411 - 3 = 408. Verified per module rather than inferred -- mail, test_mail and mail_group are all now laned, as are all five speech modules.

Attribution: at the onto-tip a1ba7203ac3 it also reads 408, but that comparison is not the usual one and says less than it appears to. Origin carries none of the five speech modules at all, so its 408 counts a different population from ours; the two numbers coincide rather than agree. What licenses this bank is the per-module check above, not that equality.

Re-measured at 888534f5019 in a clean detached worktree.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

Re-measured at f189ed18b23, in a clean worktree, and re-stamped: the old floor of 410 named a commit the 2026-09-02 sync replayed away, so architecture.yml was exiting 2 asking to be re-measured rather than comparing anything. 414 before the speech lane, 411 after it -- the three are test_speech, mail_speech and speech_ai, whose 87 tests were named by no workflow at all. The number is not debt driven down by a repair; it is a census of modules whose suites no lane runs, and it moves only when a lane names one.
